definition: Sotos syndrome is an overgrowth condition present from birth or developing after birth, usually involving greater height and head size than expected. In psychology and counselling contexts, it is relevant because motor and cognitive development can be delayed, and it may also occur with features such as low muscle tone, seizures, scoliosis, jaundice in newborns, advanced bone age, and an increased adult risk of tumors.
